title: Microsoft Purview: sensitivity label groups replace parent labels (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, portal controls and documented migration effects are supported. It correctly distinguishes the government-cloud roadmap target from cloud-neutral Learn guidance and avoids recommending PowerShell switches whose effects Microsoft has not documented.

claims.claim: The roadmap feature belongs to Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Purview"]

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to simplify sensitivity labeling to labels and label groupings.
claims.quote: the sensitivity labeling scheme will be simplified to only consist of labels and label groupings.

claims.claim: The groupings organize and categorize labels, previously done through parent labels.
claims.quote: These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).
